text: When did you last do something just because it made you happy? What was it?
What's one thing that always makes you smile? Can you do it today?
If your feelings were weather today, would they be sunny, cloudy or stormy?
What does your body feel like when you're angry? Hot? Tight? Wobbly?
When you feel cross, what helps you calm down? A hug, a drink of water, some quiet?
Did you feel left out today? It's OK to tell someone you trust.
Name three things you're good at. Yes, three!
What's something brave you did this week?
Is there something worrying you? Worries feel smaller when you share them.
Can you be cross with someone and still love them? (Yes, you can!)
How can you tell when someone's feelings are hurt? What do their faces look like?
Take 5 big balloon breaths. In through your nose… and out slowly.
What's your favourite place in the whole world? Imagine you're there for a moment.
What would you like more of this week: hugs, play time or quiet time?
Who made you feel happy today? What did they do?
Did you make a mistake today? Everybody does. What did you learn?
What's a song that makes you want to dance?
If you could give yourself a superhero name, what would it be?
Is there something you want to say but it feels too hard? You could write it or draw it.
What do you need right now: a snack, a rest, a cuddle or to run around?
Say something kind to yourself, like you would to your best friend.
What made you laugh this week?
When you feel sad, who can you go to?
What's something new you'd like to try?
You matter. Your feelings matter. 💛
When was the last time you did something just because you enjoyed it – not for marks, likes or anyone else?
What's taking up the most space in your head this week?
What do you do when you're angry – and does it help you?
When you feel rejected, what's the story you tell yourself? Is it the whole story?
Is there someone you might have hurt without meaning to? What would help?
Can you disagree with someone and still love them? Think of someone you do this with.
What helps you switch off: music, sport, sleep, time alone, time with people?
Who in your life makes you feel like you can just be yourself?
What's one thing you'd like the adults at home to understand about you?
How much sleep did you get this week? Your mood notices.
What's something you used to love that you've stopped doing? Could you pick it up again?
Scrolled a lot today? Try 10 minutes without your phone and notice how you feel.
What's one small thing you're proud of this week?
If talking feels too hard, could writing it down help?
What's a boundary you need right now – and who do you need to tell?
Is there a conversation you're avoiding? What's the smallest first step?
What does 'looking after myself' look like for you this week?
You don't have to have it all figured out. What's one thing you do know?
Who could you ask for help with something you're struggling with?
What would you tell a friend who felt the way you feel today?
Notice one thing you're grateful for, even on a rough day.
When did you last feel really calm? Where were you?
What song matches your mood right now?
Being angry is OK. What you do with it is what matters.
If you're not OK, that's allowed. Who could you tell? 💛
When was the last time you did something simply because it made you happy?
What do you need this week that you haven't asked for?
What happens in you when you feel rejected – and what do you usually do next?
What do you do when you're angry? What would you like to do instead?
How do you know when you're hurting someone? What signs might you miss?
Can you disagree with someone at home and still let them know you love them?
Is there a rupture at home that still needs repair? Repair isn't pretending it didn't happen.
When did you last rest without feeling guilty about it?
What's one thing you used to love doing before life got busy?
What's one small way to look after yourself today – water, a walk, an early night?
Who looks after you? When did you last let them?
What's a pattern from your own childhood you'd like to keep – and one you'd like to change?
Notice how you talk to yourself today. Would you speak to a friend like that?
What are you carrying this week that you could put down, even for an hour?
When talking feels too hard, writing can help. Is there a letter you need to write?
What's one thing that went well at home this week? Notice it.
What does your body tell you when you're stressed? Where do you feel it?
Have you had a moment of fun this week – just for you?
What would 'good enough' look like today, instead of perfect?
Is there someone you need to forgive – or ask forgiveness from?
What's one boundary that would protect your energy this week?
When did you last laugh properly? What was it?
What helps you come back to yourself after a hard day?
Who could you reach out to this week, just to talk?
You can't pour from an empty cup. What would refill yours today? 💛
